tools.name: vault_subscribe_pro
tools.description: Change the wallet’s Agent Vault plan, charged from platform credits. pro = 10 GB + the last 10 snapshots of each agent ($3/month, $30/year); max = 50 GB + unlimited snapshots ($5/month, $50/year); free = cancel at period end. Yearly is two months free. Upgrades are charged immediately and prorated against the unused period; downgrades and cancellations take effect at period end. A plan change never deletes snapshots. ALWAYS confirm the plan and the charge with the user before calling.

computeApiKey.description: Singularity compute API key (dashboard → Settings → API Keys, or minted by `agentvault login`)

plan.description: Plan to move to; "free" cancels at period end

interval.description: Billing period; yearly is two months free

tools.name: vault_how_to_backup
tools.description: How to actually CREATE or RESTORE an encrypted backup. Encryption is zero-knowledge and must run on the machine where the agent lives — this returns the exact CLI/SDK steps.

tools.name: list_dataset_pricing
tools.description: What a generated training dataset costs and which models can generate it: per-100-example rates for each managed tier plus the decentralized grid, the maximum size, and the model catalog with published per-million-token rates. No auth, no payment. Call this before quoting a job.

tools.name: request_dataset_payment
tools.description: Step 1 of buying a training dataset: submit the job and get back an x402 payment challenge with the exact price. Nothing is charged and nothing is generated yet. Pass the SAME arguments to create_dataset_with_payment: the server binds the payment to this exact job and refuses a mismatch.

description.description: What the model being trained should do, in one plain sentence

seedExamples.description: 5 to 20 example conversations showing the behaviour you want

targetRows.description: How many examples to generate (50-2000). Price scales with this

network.description: Chain you will pay on (default base)

modelTier.description: Managed model speed/quality tier. Omit when using gridModel

modelId.description: Exact managed model from list_dataset_pricing (decides the tier and price)

gridModel.description: Model on the decentralized encrypted grid: cheaper, slower, data never leaves the network

systemPrompt.description: Standing instruction every generated example should follow

rules.description: House rules the assistant must NEVER break, e.g. "Never promise a refund". Without them the model invents its own policy, differently each time

verify.description: Check every row with a second model and regenerate any that break the rules. ON by default, priced separately ($0.10 per 100 managed, $0.03 per 100 grid where the grid checks its own work so nothing leaves the network). false = skip checking, pay generation only

webhookUrl.description: Public HTTPS URL to notify when the dataset is ready; the POST is signed

tools.name: create_dataset_with_payment
tools.description: Step 2 of buying a training dataset: submit the job again with the signed x402 payment (v2 or v1) and the quote id. Returns in seconds with a dataset id and a claim token; generation then runs in the background. SAVE THE CLAIM TOKEN — it is shown once and is the only way to read the job or download the result.

tools.name: cloud_pod_exec
tools.description: Run a shell command inside one of your Agent Pods, including a Coding sandbox (agent_id coding), as the unprivileged pod user, in its workspace, up to 5 minutes, 1 MB output per stream. listOnMarketplace.description: Whether to list the endpoint publicly

tools.name: request_endpoint_topup_payment
tools.description: Return the x402 payment challenge (v1 JSON body plus, when the server sends it, the decoded v2 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header as paymentRequired) needed to top up credits for an existing agent endpoint. Accepts either a dashboard PAT with mcp:endpoints:write or mcp:* or a legacy endpoint API key.

slug.description: Slug of the endpoint to top up

accessToken.description: Your dashboard MCP personal access token (sgl_pat_*). Can be omitted when the connection sends Authorization: Bearer sgl_pat_*

tools.name: topup_endpoint_with_payment
tools.description: Complete an endpoint credit top-up after you have obtained a valid signed x402 payment (v2 or v1). Accepts either a dashboard PAT with mcp:endpoints:write or mcp:* or a legacy endpoint API key. If the reply is HTTP 202 with status settlement_pending (or fulfilment_pending / needs_review), the payment may already have gone through: do NOT sign a new payment; call this tool again later with the SAME paymentPayload (pending top-ups are also credited automatically). One payment tops up once: a repeat returns already_applied; reuse for another endpoint returns 409 payment_already_used (nothing charged).

slug.description: Slug of the endpoint to top up

paymentPayload.description: Signed x402 payment from the paying client (v2 relayed as PAYMENT-SIGNATURE, v1 as X-Payment), as JSON or base64 string

accessToken.description: Your dashboard MCP personal access token (sgl_pat_*). Can be omitted when the connection sends Authorization: Bearer sgl_pat_*

tools.name: request_product_purchase_payment
tools.description: Return the x402 payment challenge (v1 JSON body plus, when the server sends it, the decoded v2 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header as paymentRequired) for purchasing a public product. This wraps the existing public /p/:id-or-slug flow and does not require owner credentials.

productIdOrSlug.description: Product slug or product ID used in the public /p/:id-or-slug purchase route

clientReferenceId.description: Optional client reference ID forwarded to the purchase flow

metadata.description: Optional metadata object forwarded to the purchase flow

tools.name: purchase_product_with_payment
tools.description: Complete a public product purchase after you have obtained a valid signed x402 payment (v2 or v1) for that product challenge.

productIdOrSlug.description: Product slug or product ID used in the public /p/:id-or-slug purchase route

paymentPayload.description: Signed x402 payment from the paying client (v2 relayed as PAYMENT-SIGNATURE, v1 as X-Payment), as JSON or base64 string

clientReferenceId.description: Optional client reference ID forwarded to the purchase flow

metadata.description: Optional metadata object forwarded to the purchase flow

tools.name: request_endpoint_credit_purchase_payment
tools.description: Return the x402 payment challenge (v1 JSON body plus, when the server sends it, the decoded v2 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header as paymentRequired) for purchasing a public credit pack from an endpoint that exposes /e/:slug?action=purchase.

slug.description: Endpoint slug for the credit-enabled endpoint

walletAddress.description: Optional wallet address to receive the purchased credits when the underlying endpoint supports it

clientReferenceId.description: Optional client reference ID forwarded to the purchase flow

metadata.description: Optional metadata object forwarded to the purchase flow

tools.name: purchase_endpoint_credits_with_payment

slug.description: Endpoint slug for the credit-enabled endpoint

paymentPayload.description: Signed x402 payment from the paying client (v2 relayed as PAYMENT-SIGNATURE, v1 as X-Payment), as JSON or base64 string

walletAddress.description: Optional wallet address to receive the purchased credits when the underlying endpoint supports it

clientReferenceId.description: Optional client reference ID forwarded to the purchase flow

metadata.description: Optional metadata object forwarded to the purchase flow

tools.name: get_agent_registry_info
tools.description: Get public ERC-8004 / Solana-8004 registry information, supported networks, worker routes, and wallet-first notes.

tools.name: request_agent_wallet_challenge
tools.description: Create a wallet-auth challenge for ERC-8004 agent registration or management. The wallet owner must sign the returned message locally; MCP does not sign with the wallet.

walletAddress.description: Wallet address that will sign the challenge

payload.description: Optional payload object to bind into the signed challenge

tools.name: verify_agent_wallet_challenge
tools.description: Verify a wallet-signed auth challenge and receive a short-lived session token for agent registry flows.

walletAddress.description: Wallet address that signed the challenge

signature.description: Wallet signature over the challenge message

signatureEncoding.description: hex for EVM, base64 for Solana

payload.description: Optional payload object that was part of the original challenge

tools.name: list_my_agent_bindable_endpoints
tools.description: List platform endpoints owned by the authenticated wallet or linked dashboard user that can be bound to ERC-8004 agents.

sessionToken.description: Wallet session token returned by verify_agent_wallet_challenge

tools.name: list_my_registered_agents
tools.description: List ERC-8004 or Solana-8004 agents owned by the authenticated wallet or linked dashboard user.

sessionToken.description: Wallet session token returned by verify_agent_wallet_challenge

tools.name: prepare_agent_registration
tools.description: Prepare a wallet-first ERC-8004 or Solana-8004 registration. The caller must later send the on-chain transaction from the same wallet and then call finalize_agent_registration.

sessionToken.description: Wallet session token with erc8004_register scope

ownerAddress.description: Owner wallet address matching the authenticated session wallet

tools.name: finalize_agent_registration
tools.description: Finalize a wallet-first agent registration after the on-chain transaction has been sent from the same wallet.

sessionToken.description: Wallet session token with erc8004_register scope

payload.description: Raw finalize payload expected by the worker, including network, stage, and transaction hash/signature fields

tools.name: prepare_agent_update
tools.description: Prepare a wallet-first update for an existing ERC-8004 or Solana-8004 agent. If metadata changes require an on-chain URI update, the response describes that action.

sessionToken.description: Wallet session token with erc8004_manage, erc8004_update, or erc8004_register scope

payload.description: Raw update payload expected by the worker, including network plus agentId or assetAddress and the requested fields to change

tools.name: finalize_agent_update
tools.description: Finalize a wallet-first update for an existing ERC-8004 or Solana-8004 agent after any required on-chain transaction has been sent from the same wallet.

sessionToken.description: Wallet session token with erc8004_manage, erc8004_update, or erc8004_register scope

payload.description: Raw finalize payload expected by the worker, including network plus agentId or assetAddress and any txHash/txSignature/tokenUri fields

tools.name: submit_agent_feedback
tools.description: Submit on-chain ERC-8004 or Solana-8004 reputation feedback through the worker feedback route. This requires the separate worker feedback API key, not a wallet session token.
